name: Gallows Remembrance

abilities.name: Smother (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The remembrance smothers one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While smothered, the target is blinded and restrained, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remembrance, and takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the remembrance's turns. The remembrance can have only one creature smothered at a time. If the remembrance takes 15 damage or more in a single turn from the smothered creature, the remembrance must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the remembrance. If the remembrance dies, a smothered creature pulls free prone by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The remembrance makes two Coils attacks.

actions.name: Coils
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Noose Drop (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, and it is grappled (escape DC 14).

generation.userConcept: a hangman's rope that remembers every neck
